samples_reviewed.question_text: A shape starts at position 3. It slides 1 space right, then 4 spaces right. Describe the total slide in one direction.
A rectangle at mark 8 slides 3 spaces left, then slides 2 more spaces left in the same direction. At what mark should the rectangle be drawn?
A triangle is drawn at space 2. It undergoes a multi-step slide: 3 spaces right, then 2 more spaces right. At which space should you draw the final triangle?
A shape slides 2 spaces right, then slides 3 more spaces right. How far did it move in all?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The describe half of this competency is well served, with items naming the movement and tracking a two-step slide to a final mark. The draw half is not: even the stem that ends At what mark should the rectangle be drawn? resolves to picking a mark label from four options, so nothing in the set requires the learner to produce a drawn image of the translated figure.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: All four slide directions do appear across the seeds, and the invariance of size and shape is probed once. Missing entirely is the effect of the slide on an actual named basic shape beyond a bare position label; most stems operate on an unnamed shape moving along a one-dimensional strip of marks or spaces rather than on a figure in the plane.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: One item offers dilation alongside rotation, translation and reflection as answer choices. Dilation is not elementary vocabulary in any strand of this curriculum and has no place in student-facing text at Grade 2 Quarter 1; putting it in front of a seven-year-old as a plausible option introduces a term from secondary transformation geometry.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Every one of the nine seeds renders as the same four-option selection type. There is no fill-in response, no grid or figure to act on, and no reverse orientation such as being told the start and finish positions and asked to describe the slide that connects them. Two seeds also produce the same rectangle-at-mark-8 stem verbatim.

competency_alignment.rationale: Several seeds shift the axis away from translation itself toward terminology recall, asking what the movement is called or for another mathematical name for a slide. Those probe naming, not the described effect of a multi-step one-direction slide, and they crowd out the positional reasoning the competency actually targets.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Slide steps run between one and four spaces per leg and starting marks stay under ten, so totals never exceed a single-digit count of spaces. That keeps the arithmetic underneath the transformation well inside early Grade 2 range.
